props.name: value
props.meaning: The stored string. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: field
props.meaning: Supplies the accessible label and the required flag.

props.name: hint
props.meaning: Explain the pipeline-step token under the control.

props.name: error
props.meaning: A message from the caller, shown in place of the parse error.

props.name: on_error_change
props.meaning: Called when the parse error appears or clears.

props.name: error_message
props.meaning: Renders the message. Default is a small destructive line under the control.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height, and the size of the swatch.

keyboard.does: Commits. On the swatch, opens the picker.
Opens the picker, from the swatch.
In the input, restores the stored value. In the picker, closes it and leaves the value alone.
Move the saturation and the value inside the picker; `Page Up` and `Page Down` move the hue. `Shift` takes ten steps.
